# Udav
### Building

Required programs:
- CMake
- Ninja (if you want to use another generator, use one with C++20 modules support)
- Conan

CMake build options:
- `UDAV_BUILD_EXTRA` &mdash; build extra modules.
- `UDAV_BUILD_UNITTESTS` &mdash; build unit tests. If enabled, bloats interpreter binary with unused testing code. Turn it off if you want to build a production binary.

```sh
# From the project root

# Install dependencies with Conan
conan install --build=missing .

# List CMake presets generated by Conan
cmake --list-presets

# Choose a preset, configure and build
cmake --preset <preset>
cmake --build --preset <preset>
```

### Testing
You can run unit tests using CTest.
```sh
ctest --progress --preset <preset>
```

Udav uses [LLVM Lit](https://llvm.org/docs/CommandGuide/lit.html) and [FileCheck](https://llvm.org/docs/CommandGuide/FileCheck.html) to run E2E tests. Ensure they are installed on your system before running the commands below.
```sh
cmake --build --preset <preset> --target check
```
